examples: The ultimate prize is a trophy.
This is the ultimate pizza.
The ultimate goal is to win.

more.def: Final, or the greatest or best of its kind.
examples: The ultimate goal is to win the cup.
That was the ultimate chocolate cake.
The ultimate winner is the one with the most points.
Ultimately, we won.
Ultimately, it is up to you.
He ultimately agreed.

more.def: After everything else, at the end.
examples: Ultimately, we won the game.
Ultimately, it is up to you to decide.
He ultimately agreed to help.
The ultra soft blanket was cozy.
An ultra bright light shone.
It is ultra cool.

more.def: Extremely, or going beyond what is usual.
examples: I love my ultra soft blanket.
The ultra bright light hurt my eyes.
She bought an ultra thin phone.

easy.def: Light the eye cannot see, which can burn skin.
examples: Ultraviolet rays burn.
The sun gives off ultraviolet light.
Ultraviolet light is invisible.

more.def: Describing light waves just beyond violet that we cannot see.
examples: Sunscreen blocks ultraviolet rays from the sun.
Ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people.
Bees can see ultraviolet patterns on flowers.
